---
title: "Preface"
---

This book, *Numerical RPy: In the Era of AI*, illustrates the
numerical methods and algorithms used to model biological systems, solve
differential equations, run simulations, and analyze data. Each
method is presented language-agnostically and then implemented in both **R** and
**Python**, so the same concept can be studied in either language.

::: {.callout-note}
This is a work-in-progress migration from the original parallel R Markdown,
Jupyter, and MATLAB materials into a single Quarto book. Chapters are being
merged and proofread one at a time; the content below is placeholder scaffolding
used to validate the build pipeline.
:::
